findings.fact: Cycle3 paths and counts are current, but independent Hash/acceptance reviews and the obligation inventory are existence-only guards. Equality/HTML/Hash snapshots are not directly required to equal the current build input map/build SHA/product SHA at this outer closure guard.

findings.bounded_correction: Require the actual independent review finite PASS fields and receipt/build/seal/evidence SHA bindings; require finalized open-obligations for this exact snapshot. Bind each final candidate receipt directly to the successful current build and binary. Keep all existing executable and scope assertions.

findings.lines: closure receipt construction; preserve initial existence check; manifest commit verification
findings.fact: The closure validator checks report links but does not record the validated README/diagnostic/closure-ledger/open-obligations source digests. The preservation script requires only that the closure receipt exists and then hashes current prose; commit validates those current manifest bytes. Build frozen_inputs deliberately excludes diagnostics and these Lab reports.
findings.impact: A prose edit after documentation checks can become freshly manifested and committed without invalidating that successful closure receipt, even while all Rust inputs remain unchanged.
findings.bounded_correction: Record SHA-256 for every newly validated textual output and closure input/report manifest in closure-checks/receipt.json, then require exactly those hashes in preserve_evidence and commit_batch before staging. Bind the closure receipt itself and validated build/product identity; preserve the existing literal path manifest and exact staging assertions.
